create_continuous_sparse_reward_env: create a ContinuousSparseRewardEnvironment instance with width and height for a 2D box arena
create_discrete_sparse_reward_env: create a DiscreteSparseRewardEnvironment with N discrete actions mapped to circular directions in a 2D grid
reset_sparse_reward_environment: reset the SparseRewardEnvironment to place agent at center and generate a random goal position
step_continuous_sparse_reward_env: step the ContinuousSparseRewardEnvironment by passing a 2D action tensor to update agent position
check_win_sparse_reward_env: check if the agent position is within reward_distance of the goal using Euclidean distance
